title: Restriction to a localized site is exact
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$. For the abelian sheaf categories [def-sp-abelian], the restriction functor $j_W^*:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$ is exact: for every short exact sequence $0\to G_1\to G_2\to G_3\to0$ on $\mathcal C$, the sequence $0\to j_W^*G_1\to j_W^*G_2\to j_W^*G_3\to0$ is exact on $\mathcal C/W$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero-exact), restriction exactness assertion

proof.text: For an object $V\to W$ of the slice, the restricted sheaf $j_W^*G$ is defined by the same section group $G(V)$, and a covering family in the slice is exactly a covering family of $V$ in $\mathcal C$. Thus the maps in the restricted sequence are the maps of the original sequence on every slice object, with the same local lifting condition for surjectivity.

source.place: Section 00XZ (section-localize), definition of the localized site and restriction

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ is a full subcategory of presheaves of abelian groups; for a morphism $\psi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ of abelian sheaves the sectionwise kernel $V\mapsto\ker\psi_V$ is again a sheaf (a compatible family of sections of $\ker\psi$ glues in $\mathcal A$ and the glued section maps to $0$ because $\mathcal B$ is separated), so it is the kernel of $\psi$ in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$, and $\psi$ is a monomorphism iff every $\psi_V$ is injective. The same holds on $\mathcal C/W$. A short exact sequence $0\to G_1\xrightarrow{f}G_2\xrightarrow{g}G_3\to0$ means: $f$ is a monomorphism, $f$ is a kernel of $g$, and $g$ is an epimorphism. The first two conditions say that every $f_V$ is injective and $f_V(G_1(V))=\ker g_V$ for every object $V$; by step 1 these sectionwise conditions on the objects $V\to W$ of $\mathcal C/W$ are instances of the same conditions on $\mathcal C$, so they hold for the restricted sequence. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective] on $\mathcal C$, $g$ is locally surjective: every $h\in G_3(V)$ lifts after restriction to the members of some covering $\{V_j\to V\}$ of $\mathcal C$. For $V\to W$ in the slice, the composites $V_j\to V\to W$ make this a covering of $V$ in $\mathcal C/W$ with the same lifts, so $j_W^*g$ is locally surjective, hence an epimorphism of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$ by the same lemma applied to the site $\mathcal C/W$. Hence $0\to j_W^*G_1\to j_W^*G_2\to j_W^*G_3\to0$ is short exact in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$.
